notes.title: Devlog - 3/11/2025
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Been a while! Apologize for the silence, there are no excuses on that. I had high expectations with deadline we have given ourselves but we keep underestimating how much work is left. I should have been more transparent.

Now with all that said, much has been accomplished in the past few months. I can give a percentage update on everything left.

Animations: 100% 

Environment: 80-90%

Main Cutscene: 80%

Pause Menu: 50%+

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482937/ec94eb57375a159f431f7f9a4a0f919e6be0c64f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482937/26188bc92a8cc219bb6d5aabe05011f50316a579.png[/img]

Thank you all!
